verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no way to assign a conversation to a teammate, and no rules that route incoming mail to a specific owner. The team features shown are shared read statuses, reply-collision indicators and @mentions in team comments. These help coordination but do not establish explicit ownership. Auto Labels and Split Inbox sort mail into the user's own tabs, which is an adjacent feature rather than routing ownership between teammates.

support.subject: As a team-lead, I can assign conversations to teammates and route incoming mail with rules so ownership is explicit
